person_note: Both supplied event quotations diagnostically establish Lindsay Boxer’s participating first-person base narration. The explicit book-specific web description says Lindsay-focused sections are first person and other-character sections are third person; independent chapter summaries and a review show that the Watcher receives numerous autonomous chapters throughout the interior, so those passages are sustained base sections rather than embedded material. The result is therefore ALTERNATING. Confidence is medium because the first-person strand is directly evidenced and the overall alternation is explicitly described, but no accessible authorized interior excerpt independently displayed the third-person prose.
